responsibility: This header publishes the GNU Modula-2 language exception enumeration and query interface for the mc-boot runtime. It defines the stable set of Modula-2 exception kinds and declares the procedures that report the current exception code or whether the current program or coroutine is in an exception state.
same_name_distinction: Defines the stable Modula-2 exception enumeration and query prototypes, whereas GM2EXCEPTION.cc provides the RTExceptions-based implementation and startup initialization of the base exception block.
